purpose: Future end-to-end acceptance scenarios for the general Studio. These are requirements, not passing test results.
sharedRequirements: Create through Studio without copying an existing film or modifying Studio core
Keep stable object IDs through edits and shot reordering
Reject stale Human or AI writes without losing authored work
Bind preview, audit and export to the same input snapshot when snapshots ship
Show rule, input identity, environment, frame coverage and limitations with each audit
Download the final video to the user's disk; do not persist it on the server or CI
Reopen the exported video and check dimensions, frame count, duration and supported audio

scenarios.name: Three scene product announcement
scenarios.aiEdit: Move the second title entry 12 frames later without moving the sound cue or other titles
checks: Title inside safe area after it settles
Audio onset within one video frame

scenarios.name: An animated chart with a spoken explanation
humanEdits: Trim a narration asset without moving the chart
scenarios.aiEdit: Explain the updated data using the existing chart component and preserve the narration asset
checks: Settled displayed values agree with an independent calculation
Aspect ratio changes preserve readable content
knownBad: A displayed value disagrees with its data
A caption is shifted across the next sentence
scenarios.notes: Narration may be imported. Speech generation and automatic transcription are not prerequisites; sentence timing can be supplied and reviewed.

scenarios.name: A simple product reveal and camera orbit
scenarios.aiEdit: Reverse the camera orbit while preserving the product, title timing and shot duration
checks: Expected camera direction from state and rendered progression
Repeatable seeks within declared rendering tolerance
knownBad: Camera orbit goes the wrong way
scenarios.notes: Use original procedural geometry or a cleared asset. Photorealistic generative finishing and character rigging are not prerequisites.
